summary: Mako Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 production results. The filing details record gold sales of 14,610 oz, revenues of US$63 million, and a cash and securities balance of US$112 million. Operational highlights include performance at the San Albino and Moss mines. No corporate transaction, strategic review, tender offer, or activist campaign is announced. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. As such, no further analysis is warranted.
